explanation: Worker isolate shutdown now joins its child workers and drops their queued messages before disposing the parent isolate. The changed queue cleanup path retains a reference to a transferred message after removing it from the vector. Locally, the parent ASan shell exited 0 on pocs/probe.js; after rebuilding, the edited shell reported an AddressSanitizer container-overflow in SerializationDataQueue::Clear. A nested-worker smoke test without transfers exited 0.
